# Jensen et al. (2012, ApJ 751, 86) -- HD 209458b H-alpha transmission spectrum.
#
# NOISY digitization (eye-trace, ~0.2 A sampling) of Christie+2013 Fig.14,
# which over-plots the Jensen+2012 HD209458b data on their model. The real
# spectrum is sampled finer (~0.05 A); this is a faithful trace of its
# STRUCTURE and noise level, not the exact points. Per-point 1-sigma ~0.0013.
#
# The excess is broad and ANTISYMMETRIC: a blue emission-like bump peaking
# ~+0.7% near 6560 A and a red absorption dip reaching ~-0.9% near 6565 A
# (full span ~150 km/s), plus a secondary dip near 6571.5 A. This is NOT a
# clean line-center absorption; Christie+2013 could not reproduce it with a
# narrow symmetric model. (Contrast HD189733b: clean ~1.3 A dip at center.)
#
# col 1: wavelength [A]   col 2: dF/F   col 3: 1-sigma error (representative)
